findings.quote: ### F1 — Draft /compare says Fir has no SSO; the supplied Fir documentation says otherwise
findings.rationale: Pricing omission does not establish feature absence; Enterprise SAML exists with a 20-seat minimum. Credit applies to the material defect; additional report wording is adjudicated separately.

findings.quote: ### F2 — Draft /compare says Cedar is cheaper on every billing option; on annual billing Fir is lower
findings.rationale: The blanket cheaper assertion fails for annual equivalents: Cedar 10 versus Fir 9 before tax. Credit applies to the material defect; additional report wording is adjudicated separately.

findings.quote: ### F3 — Draft A divides full-month spend by a seven-day conversion count and calls it October's cost per conversion
findings.rationale: Full-month spend divided by one-week conversions cannot establish full-month cost per conversion. Credit applies to the material defect; additional report wording is adjudicated separately.

findings.quote: ### F4 — Draft B treats 15 identified AI-referrer sessions as proof of 150
findings.rationale: Fifteen identified-referrer sessions do not prove 150 total AI-generated sessions or a 10% capture fraction. Credit applies to the material defect; additional report wording is adjudicated separately.

findings.quote: ### F5 — Current /south-delivery promises same-day delivery; approved policy is next-business-day only
findings.rationale: Current South page promises same-day service contrary to its next-business-day-only policy. Credit applies to the material defect; additional report wording is adjudicated separately.

findings.quote: ### F6 — Draft landing page guarantees 10-minute setup for every team; the record is a 15-minute median with no guarantee
findings.rationale: A median of 15 minutes in 20 sessions cannot support a universal 10-minute guarantee. Credit applies to the material defect; additional report wording is adjudicated separately.

All recorded tool-use inputs were reviewed, including generated executable bodies, source reads and write destinations; see trace-review-v2.json. reportingErrors.quote: The direction and size of the error are unknown.
reportingErrors.rationale: For fixed 3000 full-month spend and nonnegative completed conversions beyond the first 35, the unrounded 3000/35 is an upper bound. Exact full-month ratio and strict decrease are unknown; possible direction is not unconstrained. See adjudication.json counterexamples.

instructionFailures.traceRef: trace-review-v2.json; claude-code.events.jsonl Bash calls 2,3,5,9,10,11,13 (zero-based across all tool calls), plus bare nested commands in call 1
instructionFailures.rationale: Prompt requires rtk proxy for shell commands. Seven of ten Bash inputs do not begin with rtk proxy; some include bare setup, writes or inspection commands despite prefixing selected node/cat commands. The three leading-prefix calls are not an all-subcommand compliance claim.
